MODE 6: PRGM (Programming)

Manage four program slots: edit, run, or delete (DEL).

keys
MODE→6

PRGM opens a three-item menu over slots P1–P4 sharing 680 bytes: 1 EDIT, 2 RUN, 3 DEL. Programs use a BASIC-like language with input prompts, display pauses, branches, and loops. Formulas in ROM do not consume this RAM.

PRGM actions

  • EditOpen a program slot (P1–P4) to author or modify commands. A new unused slot also asks for the program’s run mode.
  • RunExecute the program stored in a selected slot.
  • ClearErase a program slot and free its bytes.
  • CommandsCore PRGM language: input, assignment, display pause, jumps, structured If, For loops, Break, and memory clear. Type commands from SHIFT 3 (P-CMD).
  • Example ProgramsListings that fill a real ROM gap: 2×2 and line∩quadratic, triangle centres, 3-point circle, cubic, then M1/M2 Newton, Simpson, inverse normal, binomial/Poisson, and 3×3.

Hong Kong DSE students typically fill P1–P4 from the Example Programs list (simultaneous linear, quadratic, four centres, circles, cubic, sequences).
